{% comment %}
  Resolves concise breadcrumb labels from collection handles or raw taxonomy labels.

  Accepts:
  - collection_handle: Explicit collection handle (optional)
  - collection: Collection object (optional)
  - default_label: Fallback label when the handle is unknown (optional)
{% endcomment %}

{%- liquid
  assign resolved_handle = collection_handle | default: collection.handle | default: '' | strip
  assign fallback_label = default_label | default: collection.title | default: '' | strip

  if resolved_handle == blank and fallback_label != blank
    assign resolved_handle = fallback_label | handleize
  endif

  assign resolved_label = fallback_label

  case resolved_handle
    when 'mommy-and-me', 'new-matching-outfits', 'popular-mommy-me-1'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.cat_mommy_me' | t
    when 'daddy-me', 'daddy-and-me'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.cat_daddy_me' | t
    when 'couples', 'couple-matching'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.cat_couples' | t
    when 'maternity'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.cat_maternity' | t
    when 'matching-outfits', 'family-matching', 'family-matching-outfits', 'new-women-outfits', 'popular-family-matching'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.cat_family_matching' | t
    when 'dresses', 'mother-daughter-matching-dresses', 'formal-dresses', 'maxi-dresses', 'midi-dresses', 'mini-dresses', 'sundresses', 'jumpsuits', 'rompers', 'skirts', 'mommy-and-me-easter-dresses', 'easter-matching-outfits', 'spring-matching-outfits'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_dresses' | t
    when 'pajamas', 'family-pajamas', 'christmas-pajamas'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_pajamas' | t
    when 'swimsuits', 'family-swimsuits'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_swimsuits' | t
    when 'trunks'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_trunks' | t
    when 'tops', 'family-tops', 'bottoms', 'leggings', 'pants', 'christmas-tops'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_tops' | t
    when 'sweaters', 'family-sweaters', 'fall-winter', 'christmas-sweaters'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_sweaters' | t
    when 'family-sets', 'matching-family-vacation-outfits'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_sets' | t
    when 'matching-hawaiian-outfits'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_hawaiian_outfits' | t
    when 'daddy-me-t-shirts', 'matching-couples-t-shirts'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_tshirts' | t
    when 'daddy-me-shirts'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_button_downs' | t
    when 'all', 'shop'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_all' | t
    when 'new-arrivals'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_new_arrivals' | t
    when 'sale'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_sale' | t
    when 'best-sellers', 'bestsellers'
      assign resolved_label = 'sections.breadcrumbs.label_best_sellers' | t
  endcase

  echo resolved_label
-%}

json echo ',"src":' echo candidate_src | strip | json echo ',"srcset":' echo candidate_srcset | strip | json echo ',"alt":' echo candidate_alt | strip | json echo ',"width":' echo blank and option_value_family_group != selected_type_family_group assign option_hidden_by_selected_type_family = true endif endif if option_disabled or option_hidden_by_selected_type_family assign option_hidden_for_filtered_dropdown = true endif assign swatch_focal_point = null if value.swatch.image assign image_url = value.swatch.image | image_url: width: 50 assign swatch_value = 'url(' | append: image_url | append: ')' assign swatch_focal_point = value.swatch.image.presentation.focal_point elsif value.swatch.color assign swatch_value = 'rgb(' | append: value.swatch.color.rgb | append: ')' else assign swatch_value = null endif assign color_tile_image = blank if picker_type == 'color_image' if value.swatch.image assign color_tile_image = value.swatch.image endif if color_tile_image product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option3 assign variant_matches_selected_options = false endif when 2 if variant.option2 == option_value_name assign variant_matches_option_value = true endif if variant.option1 != product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option1 assign variant_matches_selected_options = false endif if variant.option3 != product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option3 assign variant_matches_selected_options = false endif when 3 if variant.option3 == option_value_name assign variant_matches_option_value = true endif if variant.option1 != product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option1 assign variant_matches_selected_options = false endif if variant.option2 != product.selected_or_first_available_variant.option2 assign variant_matches_selected_options = false endif endcase if variant_matches_option_value and variant_matches_selected_options and {% comment %}
  Renders a swatch input component.
  Accepts:
  - id: {String} unique input id
  - type: {String} input type. Accepts 'radio' or 'checkbox', defaults to 'radio' (optional)
  - name: {String} input name,
  - value: {ProductOptionValueDrop} input value
  - swatch: {SwatchDrop} the swatch drop
  - product_form_id: {String} id of the form associted with the input
  - checked: {Boolean} default checked status
  - disabled: {Boolean} default disabled status (optional)
  - visually_disabled: {Boolean} style the swatch as disabled, but leave the input enabled (optional)
  - shape: {String} swatch shape. Accepts 'square', defaults to circle (optional)
  - help_text: {String} additional content to render inside the label (optional)

  Usage:
   {% render 'swatch-input',
      id: input_id,
      name: input_name,
      value: input_value,
      swatch: swatch,
      product_form_id: product_form_id,
      checked: checked
    %}
{% endcomment %}

<input
  type="{{ type | default: 'radio' }}"
  id="{{ id }}"
  name="{{ name }}"
  value="{{ value }}"
  form="{{ product_form_id }}"
  class="swatch-input__input{% if visually_disabled %} visually-disabled{% endif %}"
  {% if checked %}
    checked
  {% endif %}
  {% if disabled %}
    disabled
  {% endif %}
>
<label
  for="{{ id }}"
  title="{{ value }}"
  aria-label="{{ value }}"
  class="swatch-input__label{% if shape == 'square' %} swatch-input__label--square{% endif %}"
>
  {% render 'swatch', swatch: swatch, shape: shape %}
  {{ help_text }}
</label>

{% comment %}
  Renders a swatch input component.
  Accepts:
  - id: {String} unique input id
  - type: {String} input type. Accepts 'radio' or 'checkbox', defaults to 'radio' (optional)
  - name: {String} input name,
  - value: {ProductOptionValueDrop} input value
  - swatch: {SwatchDrop} the swatch drop
  - product_form_id: {String} id of the form associted with the input
  - checked: {Boolean} default checked status
  - disabled: {Boolean} default disabled status (optional)
  - visually_disabled: {Boolean} style the swatch as disabled, but leave the input enabled (optional)
  - shape: {String} swatch shape. Accepts 'square', defaults to circle (optional)
  - help_text: {String} additional content to render inside the label (optional)

  Usage:
   {% render 'swatch-input',
      id: input_id,
      name: input_name,
      value: input_value,
      swatch: swatch,
      product_form_id: product_form_id,
      checked: checked
    %}
{% endcomment %}

<input
  type="{{ type | default: 'radio' }}"
  id="{{ id }}"
  name="{{ name }}"
  value="{{ value }}"
  form="{{ product_form_id }}"
  class="swatch-input__input{% if visually_disabled %} visually-disabled{% endif %}"
  {% if checked %}
    checked
  {% endif %}
  {% if disabled %}
    disabled
  {% endif %}
>
<label
  for="{{ id }}"
  title="{{ value }}"
  aria-label="{{ value }}"
  class="swatch-input__label{% if shape == 'square' %} swatch-input__label--square{% endif %}"
>
  {% render 'swatch', swatch: swatch, shape: shape %}
  {{ help_text }}
</label>
